description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the shell log backend in Zephyr OS, including macros for creating backend instances, control blocks, and function prototypes for enabling, disabling, and processing log messages.

methods.name: z_shell_log_backend_output_func
methods.description: Outputs processed log data, taking data buffer, length, and context as parameters.

methods.name: z_shell_log_backend_enable
methods.description: Enables the shell log backend with specified backend instance, context, and initial log level.

methods.name: z_shell_log_backend_disable
methods.description: Disables the specified shell log backend.

methods.name: z_shell_log_backend_process
methods.description: Processes one log entry for the given backend, returning true if a message was processed.
